_spec: SNG-642 §1–§2 — staged, not merged. Three hunger arcs (one per authored Sovereign) whose stage names ARE Erik's qualitative readings; publicFace is what anyone knows; onceLineKnown unlocks when a line of that Sovereign is confirmed (SNG-641 §2, {power} filled with the confirmed power's name); onceNamed unlocks only when the save knows the Sovereign's name. sovereignGM and onceNamed are never player-facing before then. formsFix is applied with the arcs, not before: until the arcs exist, pointing forms at them would be a dangling id.

arcs.name: The Long Petition
arcs.tendency: People are asking for what they used to earn, and the asking is being answered. It has its own causes — scarcity, ambition, the Mavens refusing claims — and something is very well fed by it.
arcs.ifIgnored: Nothing is had any more without being asked for, and nobody can say who it is owed to.
arcs.ifEngaged: Holds that do not petition, legions that need no favour, allies with somewhere else to go. Refusing to ask is the whole of the fight.

stages.name: Favours
stages.publicFace: People are asking for more than they used to — a word put in, a door held open — and most of the asking is being answered.
stages.onceLineKnown: Some of the answers come through {power}.
stages.onceNamed: The Hollow King is being asked, and every yes is a meal.
stages.pressureOnAdvance: toward: claims pressed by petition instead of merit; a lord who would rather be granted than recognised

effects.why: everyone is keeping track of who asked whom

stages.name: Bargains
stages.publicFace: People are trading things they cannot get back for things they want now — a name, a harvest, a year.
stages.onceLineKnown: {power} is where the bargains are struck.
stages.onceNamed: Every bargain is a grant from the Hollow Court, and the grant is the hunger.
stages.pressureOnAdvance: toward: debts that outlive the debtor; a seat taken with a grant the Mavens will not recognise

effects.why: nobody lends without a paper any more
people are buying what they were promised

stages.name: Hard Bargains
stages.publicFace: Someone is collecting on the old ones. Debts nobody remembers taking on are being called in, and the collector is patient and polite.
stages.onceLineKnown: {power} has started collecting for someone else.
stages.onceNamed: He has come to collect in person — diminished, courteous, and going after whoever taught people to stop asking.
stages.pressureOnAdvance: toward: the people who refused to petition, one by one

effects.why: the notches on the door frames are being counted

stages.name: Full Bargains
stages.publicFace: Nothing is had without being asked for. Every roof, every title, every meal is owed to someone, and nobody can say who.
stages.onceLineKnown: Every power you know answers to a grant.
stages.onceNamed: The Hollow King holds the Wild Half entire, and the world is his petition.

effects.why: nothing is free, and everyone knows the price of asking

arcs.name: The Glare
arcs.tendency: More is being said in public, and less is being kept. It has its own causes — boards, arenas, zeal for accountability — and something ancient is very well fed by it.
arcs.ifIgnored: Nothing is held back anywhere, and nobody remembers what it was to have an inside.
arcs.ifEngaged: Privacy kept on purpose. The Harborward's keeping, a banked fire, a thing left unsaid because it is nobody's business.

stages.name: Exposure
stages.publicFace: More is being said in public than it used to be. People confess before they are asked, and the boards are full.
stages.onceLineKnown: {power} is where the looking is done.
stages.onceNamed: Lucifer is being looked at, and every glance is a meal.
stages.pressureOnAdvance: toward: public marks without records; spectacle where there was privacy

effects.why: everyone is being watched, and knows it

stages.name: Glare
stages.publicFace: Privacy has started to look like guilt. A shut door is a question, and a drawn curtain gets you marked.
stages.onceLineKnown: {power} marks the ones who keep something back.
stages.onceNamed: The marks are his: he cannot bear an inside, anywhere.
stages.pressureOnAdvance: toward: the Umbral and the Harborward pressed to open; shutters taken down

effects.why: a closed door is an accusation
every road is watched and every traveller is asked their business

stages.name: Scouring Light
stages.publicFace: Something is looking. Hidden things are dragged into the open — and the people who kept them are going missing, one by one.
stages.onceLineKnown: {power} is hunting keepers of secrets for someone else.
stages.onceNamed: He has come — as Eosphor, diminished, casting no shadow — and he is after whoever taught people to keep an inside.
stages.pressureOnAdvance: toward: the keepers, the banked fires, the Deep Lantern

effects.why: nobody can say who is watching, only that someone is

stages.name: No Shade
stages.publicFace: There are no secrets left to keep, and there is nowhere to stand out of the light.
stages.onceLineKnown: Every power you know reports to the board.
stages.onceNamed: Lucifer holds the Light entire, and there is no in anywhere.

effects.why: there is nothing left to hide and no one left who remembers wanting to

arcs.name: The Long Sleep
arcs.tendency: More people are leaving their bodies behind — to thought, to the Cogitarium, to a sleep they do not wake from. It has its own causes, and something with no body is very well fed by it.
arcs.ifIgnored: The flesh is a coat, and everyone knows someone who lent theirs out.
arcs.ifEngaged: Staying in the body on purpose. Waking the sleepers, breaking the trade, honouring the flesh as more than a vessel.

stages.name: Drowsing
stages.publicFace: More people are sleeping longer. Nobody is sick — they are resting, and waking a little further away.
stages.onceNamed: The Unbodied is being offered bodies, and every sleeper is a meal.
stages.pressureOnAdvance: toward: Cogitants abandoning the flesh; a trade in the sleeping

effects.why: someone in every street sleeps too long

stages.name: The Long Sleep
stages.publicFace: Sleepers who do not wake are being cared for, moved and bought. There is a trade in bodies nobody is using.
stages.onceLineKnown: {power} moves sleeping bodies for a buyer who pays well.
stages.onceNamed: The buyer is the Unbodied, and the bodies are its wardrobe.
stages.pressureOnAdvance: toward: sleepers moved in crates; families paid for relatives who will not wake

effects.why: everyone is buying something to keep them awake

stages.name: Wearing
stages.publicFace: Some of the sleepers have got up — and they walk like people who have never had legs.
stages.onceLineKnown: {power} is fetching back the ones who ran for someone else.
stages.onceNamed: It has come, in a body it took, and it is after whoever taught people to stay in theirs.
stages.pressureOnAdvance: toward: the embodied, the Choirmistress, anyone waking sleepers

effects.why: you cannot tell who is wearing whom

stages.name: Empty Houses
stages.publicFace: Whole households are asleep, and some of the waking ones are not who they were.
stages.onceLineKnown: Every power you know trades in the sleeping.
stages.onceNamed: The Unbodied holds the Mind entire, and the body is a garment it changes daily.

effects.why: the people are the same shape and not the same people

lucifer._why: _formsWhy said: the day an arc is authored for the Light seat, this one field makes him arrive. This is that arc.

diminished.name: The Hollow King, diminished
diminished.note: ⚑ R41: arriving IS diminishment. He accepts a shape to act here and it is a fraction of what held the court.

final.name: The Hollow King of the Wild Half
final.note: ⛔ final form at the mythic floor.

the_hollow_king._why: DATA DEFECT: npcs/the_hollow_king.json authors forms as an ARRAY [{stage,level,name,why}]; engine/sovereign.js reads an OBJECT {diminished,final}, so his forms are never honoured. Same content, the reader's shape.

diminished.note: ⚑ R41: arriving is diminishment — and for the Unbodied it is literal. To act here it must take a body, and the body is the diminishment.

final.note: ⛔ final form at the mythic floor: it has chosen the body it will keep.

the_ninefold_ascendant._why: No forms were authored, so it could never arrive. R41's values.

luciferMask.name: Eosphor
luciferMask.title: the Dawn Seraph
luciferMask.showsAs: a Seraph of the Radiant world — human-seeming, radiant, gold-looking
tells: cannot lie — turns a question with a truer, more interesting thing
bleeds white light that does not pool; every Seraph wound shows gold (RULED)
luciferMask.reader: while the save does not know him, every GM line that would name Lucifer names Eosphor
